tasks.title: Complete safe archive entry actions
tasks.objective: Provide hierarchy/search/sort, preview and selected extraction to chosen storage.
tasks.implementation: Use stable entry identity and explicit destination capabilities. Bound entry preview and route existing viewers safely; display unsupported actions instead of fake copy/extract success.
tasks.expected_outcome: Usable entry-level actions across supported destinations.
tasks.validation: Actual UI selection/search, duplicate names, opaque SAF destinations, cancelled picker, denied/read-only targets and corrupt entries. Verify exact selected output set and unaffected siblings.

tasks.title: Reconcile interrupted extraction and publication
tasks.objective: Preserve recoverability across cancellation and ambiguous destination publication.
tasks.implementation: Record sufficient operation phases and owned temporary identities before mutation. On restart reconcile only known outputs, preserve the only good copy and require explicit conflict handling for ambiguity.
tasks.expected_outcome: Retryable extraction with safe cleanup and honest Tasks status.
tasks.validation: Fault every journal/stage/publish boundary; restart, low space, provider disconnect, external replacement and cancellation. Owned native process-kill fixtures only within authorization; no user-file cleanup.

tasks.title: Complete ZIP creation progress and cancellation reliability
tasks.objective: Make supported ZIP creation predictable through progress, cancellation and failures.
tasks.implementation: Reuse verified staging/queue and terminal progress rules. Add missing compression/destination controls, bounded buffers and intentional background ownership. Evaluate new write formats/encryption separately; no universal pause/resume claim.
tasks.expected_outcome: Correct ZIP outputs and clear terminal/recovery behavior.
tasks.validation: Byte-for-byte extracted contents, large-count/small-buffer tests, no-clobber collision, cancelled/low-space/disconnected writes, throttled progress and no orphaned owned temp artifacts.

tasks.title: Implement isolated Cloud Connect account/page contracts
tasks.objective: Prepare provider-qualified account identity and bounded pagination without fake connectivity.
tasks.implementation: Follow the existing ninth-plugin plan. Add narrow revision/capability/page/completion contracts and mock tests; retain current backends. Refresh official auth/scope research only where needed. Do not expose Connect until a real connector is usable.
tasks.expected_outcome: Reusable tested contracts with explicit registration/provider decisions left visible.
tasks.validation: Account separation, opaque IDs, page duplicates/continuations, cancellation, 429/retry, revision conflict and credential-generation mocks. No real auth/transfer completion without scoped registration/test-account evidence.

tasks.title: Audit resolved dependencies and harden build provenance
tasks.objective: Resolve dependency/security/build uncertainty while preserving reproducibility.
tasks.implementation: Inventory exact resolved runtime/transitive artifacts, SBOM/notices and official advisories. Review Actions pinning and wrapper integrity. Upgrade one justified compatible cluster per PR, retain JDK/API/Compose constraints and avoid blanket newest-version churn.
tasks.expected_outcome: Traceable dependency decisions and reproducible artifact verification.
tasks.validation: Official-source date/URLs, resolved graph and licence records; static/unit/native/R8 checks affected by each change, APK size delta and existing release tamper guards. No secrets or private signing assets in outputs.

tasks.title: Assemble stable plugin/provider/accessibility acceptance
tasks.objective: Run only implemented features through the full stable acceptance matrix and expose gaps.
tasks.implementation: Consume completed slices from C002–C047 and Codex accepted work. Test eight journeys plus local/SAF/SD/USB/network, access revocation, R8, low space, recreation and accessibility where advertised. Fix failures in focused PRs. Final stable certification requires all applicable prior feature gates.
tasks.expected_outcome: An exact-candidate pass/fail/blocked matrix suitable for a release decision.
tasks.validation: Record head/app tree, device/API, fixture/artifact/signer hashes, counts, logs and failures. Skipped/missing hardware cases stay pending. No stable promotion until every required gate passes.
tasks.external_gate: Hardware/provider accounts or disruptive owned-fixture tests may require specific existing or new authorization.

tasks.title: Collect comparable performance evidence when permitted
tasks.objective: Measure changes without claiming speedups from functional tests.
tasks.implementation: Prepare reproducible metadata and baseline/candidate analysis now. The owner-deferred benchmark remains deferred: do not invoke macrobenchmark/root probes or increase corpus budgets. Resume device measurements only when the owner explicitly reauthorizes the needed scope.
tasks.expected_outcome: Comparable startup/list/search/frames/memory/preview/archive and size evidence, or explicit deferred results.
tasks.validation: Same device/build mode/corpus/cache/thermal conditions, enough samples and p50/p95 with counts; keep raw traces and failures. Baseline profiles and optimization claims require actual attributable measurements.
tasks.external_gate: Device benchmarking explicitly deferred; permissions unchanged. This task cannot be marked accepted while required measurements are absent.

tasks.title: Deliver the complete coordination report and next backlog
tasks.objective: Give Codex a complete, evidence-based account of this 50-task batch.
tasks.implementation: Maintain interim reporting after each PR and write the final report only after all prior tasks are accepted; otherwise label it interim. Reconcile original M/U/N42 scopes and document residual requirements, rejected alternatives, open PRs and release blockers. Append subsequent approved tasks without changing this batch denominator.
tasks.expected_outcome: A reviewable report, accurate progress and prioritized follow-on work.
tasks.validation: Every task links source/PR/current evidence or explicit blocker; verify percentages and links. Codex reviews report and release readiness. All 50 tasks alone do not establish all N42 groups or stable release completion.
